sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: Good morning, North College Library.
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 早上好，北学院图书馆。

sentences.en: How can I help you?
sentences.zh: 我能帮您什么忙吗？

sentences.en: MAN: was wondering if it was possible to join the library.
sentences.zh: MAN: 我想了解一下，是否可以加入图书馆。

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: Are you a student at North College?
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 您是北学院的学生吗？

sentences.en: MAN: No, I'm not, but someone told me it was possible to join, even if I wasn't.
sentences.zh: MAN: 不是，我不是，但有人告诉我，即使不是学生也可以加入。

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: That's right, it is.
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 没错，确实可以。

sentences.en: Are you over 18?
sentences.zh: 您年满18岁了吗？

sentences.en: That's our minimum joining age.
sentences.zh: 这是我们入会的最低年龄要求。

sentences.en: Example
sentences.zh: 示例

sentences.en: MAN: Yes, I am.
sentences.zh: MAN: 是的，我已满18岁。

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: That's no problem then.
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 那就没问题了。

sentences.en: MAN: Could you tell me what I have to do to join?
sentences.zh: MAN: 您能告诉我加入需要办理哪些手续吗？

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: Well, you'll need to come in to the library and fill out some forms.
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 嗯，您需要亲自来图书馆填写一些表格。

sentences.en: You'll also need to bring two passport photos with you.
sentences.zh: 您还需要带上两张护照照片。

sentences.en: We also need two documents for ID, so a driving licence would be fine.
sentences.zh: 我们还需要两份带照片的身份证明文件，因此驾照就可以。

sentences.en: MAN: I've got that and what else?
sentences.zh: MAN: 我有驾照，还需要什么？

sentences.en: A credit card?
sentences.zh: 信用卡可以吗？

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: No, it needs to have your address on it.
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 不行，其中一份证件上必须显示您的住址。

sentences.en: MAN: Shall I bring a bank statement, would that do?
sentences.zh: MAN: 那我带一份银行对账单可以吗？这样行不行？

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: That'll be finc.
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 这样可以。

sentences.en: MAN: Good.
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的。

sentences.en: Does it cost anything to join?
sentences.zh: 加入需要付费吗？

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: Well, it's free for students here but otherwise it's £125 per year or £25 if you've got a current student card from another college.
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 嗯，本校学生免费，否则每年收费125英镑；如果您持有其他学院有效的学生证，则只需25英镑。

sentences.en: MAN: was at Westerly College until last year but now I've got a job at Jefferson's steel factory.
sentences.zh: MAN: 我去年之前在韦斯特利学院就读，但现在我在杰斐逊钢铁厂工作。

sentences.en: Er, it's more expensive than I thought.
sentences.zh: 呃，这比我预想的要贵。

sentences.en: My local library is frec.
sentences.zh: 我家附近的图书馆是免费的。

sentences.en: www.TopSage.com Tapescripts † SLA
sentences.zh: www.TopSage.com 录音稿 † SLA

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: But you'll find they don't have the range of reference books or facilities which we buy for our students.
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 但您会发现，它们没有我们为学生采购的那么丰富的参考书和设施。

sentences.en: That's why you have to pay to be an external member. com
sentences.zh: 正因如此，外部会员才需要付费。

sentences.en: MAN: I sec.
sentences.zh: MAN: 我明白了。

sentences.en: How many books can I borrow?
sentences.zh: 我可以借多少本书？

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: We allow twelve items borrowed at any one time if you're a student, and that includes CDs, DVDs and videos.
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 如果您是学生，我们允许同时借阅12件资料，其中包括CD、DVD和录像带。

sentences.en: However, it's only eight items for members of the public.
sentences.zh: 不过，公众会员只能借阅8件物品。

sentences.en: MAN: Fine.
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的。

sentences.en: And how long can I have them for?
sentences.zh: 那我最多可以借多久？

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: Well, you can have both fiction and reference books for four weeks which isn't bad really.
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 小说类和参考类图书均可借阅四周，其实这个期限已经相当不错了。

sentences.en: MAN: And what happens if I return them late?
sentences.zh: MAN: 如果我逾期归还，会怎样处理？

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: Like all libraries there's & fine system in place.
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 和所有图书馆一样，我们实行罚款制度。

sentences.en: The minimum fine is £1,50 but it can be much higher for some items - up to £5 per week.
sentences.zh: 最低罚款为1.50英镑，但某些资料的罚款可能高得多——最高可达每周5英镑。

sentences.en: We'll give you a booklet with all the details when you join.
sentences.zh: 您入会时，我们会为您提供一本包含所有详细信息的小册子。

sentences.en: You can always renew items if they're not required by anyone else by telephoning or logging on to our website.
sentences.zh: 只要所借资料未被他人预约，您总可以通过电话或登录我们的网站进行续借。

sentences.en: MAN: What about the computers?
sentences.zh: MAN: 那电脑呢？

sentences.en: Can I use them free of charge?
sentences.zh: 我可以免费使用吗？

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: For college students it's free, but for external members like yourself, the first hour is free and then we make a nominal charge of £1 per hour thereafter.
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 对大学生免费，但对外部成员（比如您）而言，首小时免费，之后每小时收取象征性费用1英镑。

sentences.en: MAN: Do I have to book in advance for them?
sentences.zh: MAN: 我需要提前预约吗？

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: Oh, yes, it's advisable.
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 哦，是的，建议提前预约。

sentences.en: Most people tend to book twenty-four hours in advance although sometimes you can get one with only six hours' notice.
sentences.zh: 大多数人通常会提前24小时预约，不过有时仅提前6小时通知也能预约到。

sentences.en: However, the carliest you can book a computer is forty-eight hours before you need it, and you can only book one hour at a time.
sentences.zh: 然而，最早只能在您需要使用电脑前48小时进行预约，且每次最多只能预约一小时。

sentences.en: If no-one else has booked the computer out, then you may be able to have another hour if you want.
sentences.zh: 如果当时没有其他人预约该台电脑，您可能可以再续用一小时。

sentences.en: We have a wide range of databases, so the computers are in great demand.
sentences.zh: 我们拥有大量数据库，因此电脑需求量很大。

sentences.en: MAN: I'm thinking of doing some writing and I might need to access national newspapers.
sentences.zh: MAN: 我打算写点东西，可能需要查阅全国性报纸。

sentences.en: Do you have them on these databases?
sentences.zh: 这些数据库里有全国性报纸吗？

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: We do indeed.
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 我们确实提供这类资源。

sentences.en: We've got all the big nationals, The Guardian and The Observer, The Independent and The Times and Sunday Times.
sentences.zh: 我们拥有所有主流全国性报纸，包括《卫报》和《观察家报》、《独立报》以及《泰晤士报》和《星期日泰晤士报》。

sentences.en: We've also got all the local papers and a wide selection of magazines.
sentences.zh: 我们还收藏了全部本地报纸及大量各类杂志。

sentences.en: MAN: Excellent. assume you have photocopying facilities?
sentences.zh: MAN: 太好了。我想你们应该有复印设施吧？

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: Of course. 5p a sheet for both A4 and A3 black-and-white copies and 40p a sheet for colour.
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 当然有。A4和A3尺寸的黑白复印均为每张5便士，彩色复印为每张40便士。

sentences.en: You can get a card from the counter here - it doesn't take coins.
sentences.zh: 您可在此处服务台购买复印卡——该卡不接受硬币。

sentences.en: MAN: OK.
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的。

sentences.en: Oh by the way, another thing I was wondering about was if you ran any writing classes through the library?
sentences.zh: 哦，对了，我还想顺便问一下，图书馆是否开设写作课程？

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: We do, but you'll have to speak to John Grantingham about that.
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 我们确实开设，但您需要与约翰·格兰特宁汉先生联系此事。

sentences.en: He's our resident author.
sentences.zh: 他是本馆驻馆作家。

sentences.en: He runs the creative writing classes.
sentences.zh: 他负责主持创意写作课程。

sentences.en: MAN: John . . .
sentences.zh: MAN: 约翰……

sentences.en: Grant .
sentences.zh: 格兰特……

sentences.en: Could you spell that for me please?
sentences.zh: 麻烦您拼写一下这个名字好吗？

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: Certainly.
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 当然可以。

sentences.en: G-R-A-N-T-I-N-G-H-A-M.
sentences.zh: G-R-A-N-T-I-N-G-H-A-M。

sentences.en: MAN: Are the classes here at the library?
sentences.zh: MAN: 这些课程是在图书馆内举办吗？

sentences.en: LIBRARIAN: Yes - he's here on Thursday evenings, oh no sorry, Friday - he's just changed it.
sentences.zh: LIBRARIAN: 是的——他每周四晚间在此授课，哦，抱歉，更正一下，是周五——他刚刚调整了时间。

sentences.en: You can contact him by emailing the library.
sentences.zh: 您可以通过向图书馆发送电子邮件来联系他。

sentences.en: MAN: Okay.
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的。

sentences.en: Right, well that's about all I need to know.
sentences.zh: 那么，我大概就只需要了解这些信息了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I'll be along later this week to join.
sentences.zh: 我这周晚些时候会过来办理入会手续。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: www.TopSage.com 7. 3-10
sentences.zh: www.TopSage.com 7. 3-10
